plan.problem: PUMPOKO 02 works on staging Pages but cannot be uploaded as a portable itch.io HTML5 ZIP because the entry HTML uses ../ paths to shared Engine and Codea.
plan.currentContract: The canonical game lives in works/pumpoko-02 and uses shared Engine 0.3.0 plus Codea Lite 1.0.0; ORBIT already uses a generic standalone exporter.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The generic exporter rewrites only the marked Engine tag; PUMPOKO also uses an unmarked separate Codea Lite reference.
plan.design: Stage a temporary copy of only manifest-listed files, copy canonical Codea Lite locally, rewrite the Codea script reference only in this temporary copy, call the canonical generic exporter for Engine rewriting, then verify the ZIP tree. A read-only workflow stores itch-ready files as an artifact.
plan.migration: No change to canonical game assets, runtime, staging Pages paths, or production.
plan.compatibility: Identical game JS/audio/bitmap/Engine bytes; only HTML references in the exported ZIP and the tab title differ.
plan.promotionRisk: An Actions workflow is a shared execution surface; keep contents:read, same-repo execution, and artifacts only, subject to PR gate and review.
